trusted_assumptions: The lower-level `<*const T>::is_aligned_to` contract relates its normal result to address divisibility by the requested alignment.
rationale: The ordinary exec function preserves the implementation's single `is_aligned_to(align_of::<T>())` call and proves the postcondition compositionally.
